title: discretize
description: `discretize(X,edges)` returns one-based bin numbers for values in `X` using numeric bin edges.
behaviors: Supports explicit edge vectors, positive scalar bin counts, string labels, and the `IncludedEdge` name-value option; the default is left-inclusive/right-exclusive with the final edge included.
Out-of-range and NaN inputs return NaN for numeric bin output or missing strings for labeled output.
